entry.name: EgoExplorer
entry.title: EgoExplorer: A Vision-Motion-Touch Observatory for Human Loco-Manipulation In Situ
entry.summary: Whole-body human loco-manipulation in 5 rooms (6 laboratory procedures, 4 household and industrial tasks), recorded with a head-mounted GoPro HERO13, 5 VIVE Ultimate trackers and gloves; the Wuji glove configuration (41% of regular recordings) adds a 24x31 pressure matrix with 526 active taxels per hand.
entry.hand: Human hands x 2 in Wuji gloves (tactile + EMF finger tracking) or MANUS Metagloves Pro (EMF finger tracking, no tactile)

sensor.note: Wuji recordings only. Per 30 Hz release row: 2 x 24 x 31 normalized taxel readings with invalid cells masked, plus 2 x 17 binary regional contact with separate validity (thumb 2 regions, other fingers 3 each, palm 3). The 24 x 31 matrix (744 cells, row-major) has 526 active points (maker spec; the paper's health mask also retains 526 of 744). Native rate 120 Hz nominal, resampled to the 30 Hz grid; contact is the logical OR of native detections in each 1/30 s bin. The paper defines raw (L0), baseline-relative (L1) and regional-contact (L2) interfaces and states the values are not calibrated force or pressure.

scale.text: Paper: 2,715 recordings, 100 h, 10 task templates, 5 environments; touch in 41% of regular recordings (Wuji gloves). Released: mini release of 18 recordings, 118,910 frames at 30 Hz (66 min), all 10 tasks

entry.access: Hugging Face InternRobotics/EgoExplorer, gated behind a Google form that is checked automatically (access in about a minute); it holds the 66-min mini release (18 recordings, 21.1 GB), and the full collection opens in stages through a waitlist.
caveats: Only the 66-min mini release (18 recordings) can be downloaded; the paper's 2,715 recordings (100 h) are opened in stages to waitlisted groups.
Touch exists only in Wuji-glove recordings: 41% of regular recordings. The MANUS recordings (58%) have finger articulation and no tactile data.

Released taxel values are normalized readings with invalid cells masked; the paper calls them contact indicators and says they are not calibrated force or pressure. The GitHub README describes them as 'calibrated taxels'.
Tactile is resampled from ~120 Hz native to the 30 Hz grid; regional contact is the logical OR of native detections inside each 1/30 s bin.
Paper statistics mark the right-hand index and central-palm regions n/a: fewer than three recordings have 30% or more live taxels there.

Whole-body SMPL-X is reconstructed from 5 trackers (head, wrists, ankles); 17 joints are inferred. The 18.0 mm / 20.3 mm body-point errors are measured against tracker-fitted reference labels, with no optical mocap reference.
Step annotations are VLM drafts reviewed by operators; the expert audit of drafts found factual errors in 11.09% of segments before correction.

The card and paper name the video key observation.images.ego; the mini release stores it as observation.images.camera_0. The repository also holds a per-task zarr copy (dataset/oxt/EgoExplorer/<task>.zarr) that the card does not describe.
Number of participants and objects not stated.
The release files were not opened for this survey (gated, access not requested); channels come from the card, the paper and the file tree.

cameras.model: GoPro HERO13 Black with Media Mod

tracking.system: 5 x VIVE Ultimate Tracker (head, both wrists, both ankles), inside-out camera tracking without base stations, 60 Hz; C3 (Calibrate-Complete-Constrain) reconstruction to metric SMPL-X
tracking.note: head tracker rigidly coupled to the GoPro, so the camera pose is measured; released as tracker poses (5 x 3 + 5 x 4) and SMPL-X body (3 + 3 + 63) on the 30 Hz grid

tracking.system: VIVE Ultimate Trackers on the glove dorsum
tracking.note: calibrated device-to-wrist transforms carry the glove frame onto the solved arm

tracking.system: Wuji glove or MANUS Metagloves Pro: five 6-DoF fingertip EMF sensors per glove, 120 Hz nominal
tracking.note: glove skeleton fitted to the SMPL-X hand (45 local axis-angle values per hand); the card lists 21-joint glove skeletons per hand in the mini release

other: step annotations (step ID, free-text description, interval bounds, skill, object roles, observed outcome)
per-episode calibration profile and quality report
validity masks, source-time mapping and interpolation flags per stream

sources: https://arxiv.org/html/2610.18872v1 (sections 3-4, appendices A, B, D.1, E, F.3, G)
https://forms.gle/2tT2dTxAYXgGXBkK6 (access form and its terms of use)
unconfirmed: Mini release counts (18 episodes, 118,910 frames, 66 min) are the card's; the files are gated and were not opened. The tree has 18 episode_meta folders (episode_000001-000018), 18 data shards and 18 camera_0 MP4s.

One episode per shard is inferred: data/chunk-000/file-i.parquet, videos/.../file-i.mp4 and episode_meta/episode_(i+1)/smplx_episode.npz sizes rise and fall together (video/data ratio 35-62). The card says a shard may hold several episodes.
Episode lengths estimated from MP4 sizes at the mean bitrate (7.0 GB over 66 min): ~50 s (file-004, 87 MB) to ~440 s (file-008, 781 MB); mean ~3.7 min.
That all 18 mini-release recordings carry Wuji tactile follows from the card ('every one with all four streams', '24x31 Wuji tactile per hand'); not checked in the files.

In the card, the mini release keeps 17-region contact under episode_meta/<episode>/, while the paper's Table 9 puts it in every row; episode_meta holds annotations/, calibration/, metadata.json, quality/ and smplx/ only, so it is not clear which file carries contact.

Hand representation: paper Table 9 gives 2 x 45 SMPL-X finger rotations per row; the card's mini-release list says both hands' 21-joint skeletons; the paper's fitting keeps 20 non-wrist landmarks from a 25-node glove layout.

The zarr copy (dataset/oxt/EgoExplorer/, one group per task, ~13.7 GB) has arrays camera_ego_rgb, camera_ego_pose, left/right_wrist_pose, left/right_hand_pose, left/right_hand_joints(_idx), left/right_tactile_{data,sensor,type,area}_wuji each with _contact and _score variants, sub_task_instruction, timestamps and meta/episode_ends. Shapes, rates and meanings were not read (gated) and are not documented.
120 Hz is the manufacturer's nominal glove rate (paper Table 8); per-recording timing follows native timestamps.

Taxel count: the Wuji product page states '24 x 31 Pressure Sensor Matrix (526 active points)'; the paper says its health mask, estimated from earlier recordings, retains 526 of 744 taxels. Sensing principle not stated by either.
Coverage 'phalanx' comes from the paper's 17-region map (3 regions on each non-thumb finger); the maker page states only full palm coverage.

Project page says '100+ hours' growing by 5 h/day and that the dataset, toolkit and reconstruction code 'will be released'; the GitHub README dates the toolkit code to early November 2026 (repository holds only README and assets on 2026-10-16).
The paper reports 545 regular Wuji recordings with healthy tactile on both hands and 565 recordings with 1,110 healthy hand streams; the total number of Wuji recordings is not stated.
Laboratory tasks are 41% of recordings (46% of duration); the other environments: study 23%, industrial workspace 17%, food-preparation area 11%, living room 8%.
Whether this account already has access was not checked; the HF token was not used.

download.format: LeRobot v3.0 under dataset/lerobot/: meta/{info.json, stats.json, tasks.parquet, episodes/chunk-000/file-000.parquet}, data/chunk-000/file-000..017.parquet, videos/observation.images.camera_0/chunk-000/file-000..017.mp4, episode_meta/episode_XXXXXX/{metadata.json, annotations/{instruction.json, segments.parquet}, calibration/calibration.json, quality/quality.json, smplx/smplx_episode.npz}; plus an undocumented zarr copy, dataset/oxt/EgoExplorer/<task>.zarr (10 groups)
download.total_size: 21.1 GB in 11,699 files (tree sum 21,065,414,766 B; HF usedStorage 24.4 GB): MP4 7.0 GB, zarr 13.7 GB, parquet 0.14 GB, episode_meta 0.16 GB
download.per_episode: data parquet 1.4-17.2 MB (median 8.0), camera_0 MP4 87-781 MB (median 360), SMPL-X npz 1.6-20.4 MB, other episode_meta files < 50 kB
download.partial_fetch: after access: single files via https://huggingface.co/datasets/InternRobotics/EgoExplorer/resolve/main/<path> (one data shard, one MP4 and one episode_meta folder per episode); zarr arrays can be fetched per chunk (camera_ego_rgb median 1.3 MB per chunk)

channels.name: observation.images.camera_0

channels.name: tracker poses (field names not read)
channels.shape: 5 x 3 position + 5 x 4 quaternion (x, y, z, w) + per-device validity
channels.frame: world: metric, right-handed, +Y up; active device-to-world rotations
channels.note: VIVE Ultimate Trackers on head, wrists (glove dorsum), ankles; native 60 Hz, linear/SLERP interpolation to 30 Hz

channels.name: body motion (SMPL-X)
channels.frame: world pelvis position (not the SMPL-X additive transl), world-relative root orientation, 21 local body-joint rotations
channels.note: C3 reconstruction from 5 trackers; shape, scale and mounts referenced by calibration-profile ID

channels.name: hand motion (SMPL-X hands)
channels.note: fitted from the glove skeleton in wrist-local coordinates; native glove rate 120 Hz nominal

channels.name: glove hand skeletons (field names not read)
channels.shape: 21 joints per hand (card); exact shape not read
channels.frame: not stated (paper fits in wrist-local coordinates)
channels.note: listed in the card's mini-release streams; Wuji or MANUS EMF fingertip tracking

channels.name: tactile readings (field names not read)
channels.unit: normalized, dimensionless; not calibrated force or pressure
channels.frame: per-hand 24 x 31 matrix, row-major, canonical layout after layout correction (GitHub README)
channels.note: Wuji recordings only; invalid cells masked; 526 of 744 cells active; native 120 Hz nominal; baselines, response normalization and region mappings accompany each recording (paper D.1)

channels.name: regional contact
channels.frame: 17 anatomical regions per hand: thumb 2, index/middle/ring/little 3 each, palm 3
channels.note: logical OR of valid native-rate detections in each 1/30 s bin; bins without valid samples masked; card puts it under episode_meta/ for the mini release

channels.name: step annotations (annotation.* row fields; episode_meta/<episode>/annotations/segments.parquet, instruction.json)
channels.note: step ID, description, interval bounds, skill, object roles, observed outcome; VLM draft from video + instruction + expert skill documents, then operator review

channels.note: stream support, source-time mapping, interpolation flags, diagnostics, review status; unavailable streams masked, never written as zeros

channels.note: calibration profile, episode metadata and quality report; contents not read

sample.reason: Files are gated (HF returns 401 without access) and access was not requested for this survey. The form is checked automatically and grants access in about a minute, and CC BY-NC 4.0 allows non-commercial redistribution, so the decision becomes 'sample' once the user submits the form.
sample.fetch_estimate: If access is granted: 6-8 episodes x (one data parquet, median 8 MB + one camera_0 MP4, median 360 MB + episode_meta, ~10 MB) = ~2.5-3.5 GB; the whole mini release is 21.1 GB. Most episodes are estimated at 1-7 min, so each needs a 10-60 s contact window; the video must be cut and re-encoded to H.264 within ~30 MB per episode.
sample.rules_applied: Gated without access -> catalog_only (pipeline/README.md step 2). Episodes cannot be mapped to tasks without meta/episodes and tasks.parquet, which are gated, so no episode list. With access: 10 tasks > 6, so take 6-8 spanning the 5 environments (e.g. weighing, extraction, rotary evaporation, cardboard box, bookshelf, clothes folding, sandwich making), one episode each, with contact above rest for at least 1 s on both hands' 24 x 31 grids.
